hooks.commandWindows: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$p='.ai\scripts\validate_implementation_approval.py'; if (Get-Command py -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { py -3 $p --hook } elseif (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { python $p --hook } elseif (Get-Command uv -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { uv run --python 3.11 python $p --hook } else { exit 1 }"
